package members_test

import (
	"context"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/security"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	pb "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/grpc/members/pb"
	members "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/members"
)

type service struct {
	calls atomic.Int32
}

func TestMounted(t *testing.T) {
	svc := &service{}
	ctx, client := mountedClient(t, members.NewEndpoints(svc))
	denied, err := client.Mount(metadata.AppendToOutgoingContext(ctx, "authorization", "bad"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = denied.RecvMsg(new(pb.MountResponse))
	require.Equal(t, codes.Unauthenticated, status.Code(err))
	require.Zero(t, svc.calls.Load())
	name := "input"
	item := "stream"
	allowed := metadata.AppendToOutgoingContext(ctx, "authorization", "valid")
	one, err := client.Mount(allowed)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, one.Send(&pb.MountStreamingRequest{Body: &pb.MountStreamingRequest_InitialPayload{InitialPayload: &pb.MountRequest{Name: &name}}}))
	require.NoError(t, one.Send(&pb.MountStreamingRequest{Body: &pb.MountStreamingRequest_StreamItem{StreamItem: &pb.MountStreamItem{Field: &item}}}))
	result, err := one.CloseAndRecv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "mount:input:stream", result.GetField())
	two, err := client.MountH(allowed)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, two.Send(&pb.MountHStreamingRequest{Body: &pb.MountHStreamingRequest_InitialPayload{InitialPayload: &pb.MountHRequest{Name: &name}}}))
	require.NoError(t, two.Send(&pb.MountHStreamingRequest{Body: &pb.MountHStreamingRequest_StreamItem{StreamItem: &pb.MountHStreamItem{Field: &item}}}))
	result2, err := two.CloseAndRecv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "mountH:input:stream", result2.GetField())
	require.EqualValues(t, 2, svc.calls.Load())
}

func (s *service) APIKeyAuth(ctx context.Context, key string, _ *security.APIKeyScheme) (context.Context, error) {
	if key != "valid" {
		return ctx, status.Error(codes.Unauthenticated, "invalid key")

	}
	return ctx, nil
}

func (s *service) Mount(_ context.Context, p *members.MountPayload, stream members.MountServerStream) error {
	s.calls.Add(1)
	value, err := stream.Recv()
	if err != nil {
		return err

	}
	return stream.SendAndClose("mount:" + p.Name + ":" + value)
}

func (s *service) MountH(_ context.Context, p *members.MountHPayload, stream members.MountHServerStream) error {
	s.calls.Add(1)
	value, err := stream.Recv()
	if err != nil {
		return err

	}
	return stream.SendAndClose("mountH:" + p.Name + ":" + value)
}
